contents.reason: The three-series converse belongs to the already-published independent-series page, not this CLT pair.

contents.name: Example 3.4.13: an infinite-variance law with a nonstandard normalizing sequence
contents.reason: The example concerns the wider normal domain of attraction and sqrt(n log n) normalization, beyond PT-9's finite-variance and normalized-array spine.

contents.name: Theorem 3.4.14: iid normal-domain-of-attraction criterion under arbitrary centering and normalization
contents.reason: This is not the Feller converse for normalized infinitesimal triangular arrays, and Durrett refers its proof to Gnedenko-Kolmogorov; the distinct theorem is outside PT-9's selected scope.

contents.name: Theorems 3.10.5-3.10.7: Cramer-Wold interface and multivariate iid CLT
Theorems 3.10.8-3.10.9: delta method
contents.reason: Nonlinear statistical asymptotics lie beyond this CLT page's linear multivariate scope and have no current planned destination.
